0022600175.text: The Celtics host the Bucks at 5-2 overall and 4-0 at home, sitting 2nd in the Atlantic, 1.5 games back, after a loss in their most recent game. Milwaukee is 1-6 and on a three-game losing streak, 14th in the East and 5th in the Central, 5 games back. Boston is without Devin Carter (illness) and Jayson Tatum (rest, averaging 27.0 points this season), and Payton Pritchard (shoulder) is day-to-day and a game-time decision, while Milwaukee's Kam Jones (ankle) is also day-to-day and a game-time decision. The Celtics won the 2025-26 season series 3-1 and beat the Bucks 133-101 in Milwaukee on April 3, 2026, and no games have been played yet in the 2026-27 series.
